parameters.name: ContentEncoding
parameters.description:
The encoding mode of the `CommandContent` and `Output` response parameters. Valid values:

*   PlainText: returns the original command content and command outputs.
*   Base64 (default): returns the Base64-encoded command content and command output.

parameters.name: IncludeOutput
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the command outputs in the response.

*   true: returns the command outputs. When this parameter is set to true, you must specify `InvokeId`, `InstanceId`, or both.
*   false (default)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller describe-invocations --invoke-id t-cd03crwys0lrls0 --node-id e01-cn-zvp2tgykr08 --include-output true --content-encoding PlainText --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eflo-controller DescribeInvocations --region cn-hangzhou --NodeId 'e01-cn-zvp2tgykr08' --ContentEncoding PlainText --InvokeId 't-cd03crwys0lrls0' --IncludeOutput true
